# Pixso

> Pixso is a free, cloud-based UI/UX design and collaboration platform offering real-time team editing, design resources, and enterprise solutions as a modern alternative to Figma.

Pixso provides comprehensive design tools for individuals and teams with options ranging from free starter plans to enterprise deployments. The platform includes collaborative features like Pixso Whiteboard, extensive design system templates, and both cloud-hosted and private deployment options for organizations of all sizes.

## Key Topics

- Real-time collaboration
- UI/UX design
- Design systems
- Team collaboration
- Design resources
- Prototyping
- Enterprise edition
- Private deployment
- Design templates
- AI credits

- Cloud-based design
- Resource library
- Professional teams

## Core Products & Features

- [Pixso - A Free Online UI/UX Design Tool](https://pixso.net): Pixso homepage: free UI/UX design and collaboration platform with real-time editing and team features
- [Pixso Whiteboard - An Online Collaborative Tool](https://pixso.net/pixso-whiteboard): Pixso Whiteboard product page for team brainstorming, planning, and collaborative ideation
- [Pixso 2.0 Lifetime Plan](https://pixso.net/pixso-lifetime-plan): Unlock lifetime access to Pixso 2.0 with unlimited design tools and plugins at the price of 2 years

## Pricing & Plans

- [Pixso Pricing Plans](https://pixso.net/pricing): Pixso pricing plans and subscription tiers for Starter, Organization, and Enterprise users
- [Pixso Organization Edition Trial](https://pixso.net/organization-application): Free trial application for Pixso Organization Edition with team management features
- [Pixso Enterprise Edition](https://pixso.net/pixso-enterprise): Enterprise Edition with admin panel, advanced team management, and organizational controls
- [Pixso Private Deployment](https://pixso.net/private-deployment): Private deployment option for secure self-hosted design collaboration as a Figma alternative

## Design Resources & Community

- [Flamingo Design System](https://pixso.net/community/file/Lg5pp9SR3QD4GdWfHuCq6w): Flamingo Design System template for download and design system learning
